com

jbannon

at

artic

dot

edu

Otherwise call the School at 312-899-5100.

Columbia College has a class also, taught by Rick Bruck in their Science Department. His e-mail is 

rabhol

at

earthlink

dot

net 

Columbia's phone is 312-663-1600.

Who knows if Fine Arts Research and Holographic Center, which calls itself a Museum of Holography, but I call them by their original name when they were a kooky off the beaten track art gallery, Gallery 1134, because those digits upside down on a pocket calculator is a better description of that place, will ever have any classes. I know of at least 3 people on their "waiting list". (I can send you an article from the Chicago Reader that explains what I mean if you wish.)

I myself do take on students every once in a while.
